## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Scope

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `mypy src`
- [ ] `pytest --cov=tinlance_sdea --cov-report=term-missing`

## Architecture

- [ ] Existing ownership boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] An ADR is included if a permanent boundary changes.
- [ ] Canonical contracts remain provider-independent.

## Security

- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data added.
- [ ] Security implications considered.
- [ ] No authorization or execution authority introduced into SDEA.

## Documentation

- [ ] README/docs updated where behavior or contracts changed.
